function auth_events_append_only().definition:

view accessible_site_members.definition:
SELECT m.site_id,
    m.user_id,
    m.role
   FROM ((site_members m
     JOIN users u ON ((u.id = m.user_id)))
     JOIN sites s ON ((s.id = m.site_id)))
  WHERE (((NOT u.demo_sandbox) AND (m.role <> 'demo_user'::text)) OR (u.demo_sandbox AND s.demo_sandbox AND (m.role <> 'owner'::text)));
